ideas.title: My friends are processes
ideas.critique: This is the round 1 'My computer' pitch (terminal in the workshop, live ASCII view, typed commands that act on the island) again, with ps/kill/nice/fork as the command list. The process metaphor for creatures is funny, but it is the same prop and the same payoff, and it carries out a named example.

ideas.title: Dream bubbles
ideas.critique: Distorted replays of each creature's logged day inside refractive glass spheres are a fresh use of logs and of dielectric, and they suit the path tracer. It is still a set of props above sleepers and a night film, and it is close to Yesterday's replay of what was done, with the bubbles popping on waking as the only small twist.

ideas.title: The hand
ideas.critique: A pointer that creatures react to is Your moth with a glove instead, and the reactions (stare, flee, sniff) are the same chase-the-cursor payoff. Picking creatures up by the scruff, dangling them and tickling sleepers is a real step toward goal 1 and is physical, but it is an expected interaction.

ideas.title: On strike
ideas.critique: Creatures refusing to play until Lumi pays up from the wish box is a funny reversal, and it changes the rules of the mini games. In form it is a gathering of friends with signs and shouted lines plus a payoff, much like You choose and the group romp films, and the negotiation is vague.

ideas.title: Where the rain goes
ideas.critique: Colouring the ground by the real drainage basins, with Wada fractal boundaries curling between three colours, is a mathematically striking visual that nothing on the island resembles. It reads as an ambient look change plus a top-down film, but the pattern is a real, unpredictable surprise, and rolling rain particles add physics.

ideas.title: Interviews
ideas.critique: A new film genre (talking heads, one key light, silences, someone wandering off) built from real logged words and moods is a witty, different way to show the creatures. It is still a Lumi-led gag film of the same family, and nothing in the game changes.
